info.name: StiQR API
info.description:
StiQR API Collection — Cloudflare Workers (Hono) — live at https://stiqr-api.ksangeeth76.workers.dev

Roles:
- admin  → platform administration + manages owners (/admin/*, /platform-admin/*)
- owner  → manages their own staff only (/owner/*)
- staff  → no management access

Authentication:
- POST /auth/login returns accessToken (15 min) + refreshToken (30 days).
- Send access tokens as: Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}
- When the access token expires, call POST /auth/refresh with the refreshToken.
- Login request auto-saves accessToken / refreshToken and the role-scoped adminToken / ownerToken collection variables.

Platform Admin (admin only):
- Dashboard, Shops, Subscription Plans, Subscriptions, Login Credentials, Payments, Platform Reports, Platform Settings.
- Maintenance mode can be toggled via POST /admin/settings/maintenance — while enabled, non-admin logins and requests return 503.

Variables:
- baseUrl: https://stiqr-api.ksangeeth76.workers.dev
- accessToken: regular session token (from login)
- adminToken: token for admin routes
- ownerToken: token for owner routes
- refreshToken: rotation token

Passwords must be 8+ chars with uppercase, lowercase, number and special character.

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: Login, token refresh/rotation, logout, registration and password management.

request.description: Log in and receive an access token (15 min) plus a refresh token (30 days). Auto-saves accessToken / refreshToken / adminToken / ownerToken collection variables. Brute-force protected: 5 failed attempts locks the account for 15 minutes.
Rotate the refresh token and receive a new accessToken + refreshToken pair. Old refresh tokens are revoked on every use (rotation).
Revoke the current refresh token (requires a valid access token).
Create a user. Role-scoped: admins may create owners, owners may create staff. Role: owner | staff.
Return the current user profile, status and effective permissions.
Change your own password. Revokes all active sessions for the account.

item.name: 🏢 Admin — Owner Management
item.description: Admin-only endpoints. Admin manages owners only — never staff directly. Requires adminToken.

request.description: List all roles with their assigned permissions.
List the full permission catalog.
Most recent 200 audit log entries (logins, user creation, suspension, password resets, deletions).
List all owners with their staff count.
Create a new owner account (admin only).
Get a single owner together with their staff list.
Update an owner's name and/or email.
Delete an owner together with all of their staff.
Suspend an owner. Takes effect immediately and revokes all sessions.
Reactivate a suspended owner.
Reset an owner's password and revoke all their sessions.

item.name: 🏪 Owner — Staff Management
item.description: Owner-only endpoints. An owner can only manage their own staff (enforced by owner_id). Requires ownerToken.

request.description: List all staff belonging to the current owner.
Create a new staff member under the current owner.
Get a single staff member (must belong to the current owner).
Update a staff member's name and/or email.
Delete a staff member (must belong to the current owner).
Suspend a staff member. Takes effect immediately and revokes all sessions.
Reactivate a suspended staff member.
Reset a staff member's password and revoke all their sessions.

item.name: 🏢 Platform Admin
item.description: Admin-only platform operations: dashboard, shops, subscription plans & subscriptions, login credentials, payments, reports and settings. All requests use adminToken.
